blocking.section: Authentication and authorization (JWT, OpenID Connect, OAuth2 row)
blocking.issue: The mechanism names Consumer fields `jwt` and `oauthClients` as if they sat directly under `Consumer.spec`. The Legend says fields are written as `spec` paths, but the Configuration model has them only under `spec.credentials` (`credentials.jwt`, `credentials.oauthClients`). The API keys row of the same table correctly writes `credentials.apiKeys`. As written, the row names a field path that does not exist (pack section 3, style guide section 5).
blocking.evidence: Line 209: "`auth.jwt` with `issuers[]` (`issuer`, `jwksUrl`, `audiences`); `Consumer` `jwt` and `oauthClients` bindings". Line 98 (Legend): "fields as `spec` paths (`match.hosts`)". Line 213: "matched by hash against `Consumer` `credentials.apiKeys`". docs/architecture/02-configuration-model.md, Consumer sketch: "credentials: ... apiKeys: ... jwt: # map keyed by issuer ... oauthClients: [{clientId: acme-portal}]". docs/architecture/08-security-and-identity.md line 162: "`credentials.jwt` by issuer plus `subject` or `claims`".
blocking.fix: Change the mechanism to: "`auth.jwt` with `issuers[]` (`issuer`, `jwksUrl`, `audiences`); `Consumer` `credentials.jwt` and `credentials.oauthClients` bindings". The word count does not change.

non_blocking.section: Authentication and authorization (Multiple identity providers per endpoint row)
non_blocking.suggestion: The note "JWT or API key on one Route: distinct slots with complementary `when`" states option (a) of the still-open OQ-configuration-model-13 as settled. The Configuration model says that all client authentication types share slot `auth`. Cite the question and the constraint from Security and identity, for example: "distinct slots with complementary `when` (OQ-configuration-model-13, option (a) per Security and identity; the Route must exclude any Gateway slot-`auth` Policy)".

Roadmap M1 exit criterion 7 requires every Open question that blocks an M1 feature to be closed. It names OQ-security-and-identity-2 explicitly. The bullet should therefore say that the rows move out of M1 rather than that M1 exits with them open. The list of rows that depend on blocking questions is also incomplete. IP filtering depends on OQ-security-and-identity-6, which blocks for `source.ip` users. The ratelimit-based rows depend on the per-Node ceiling in OQ-traffic-management-and-resilience-1, which blocks M1. Either add these rows or say why they are excluded.
